body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 1-unit burst within 5 units. Compare this Action against each creature in the burst. On a success, deal 1 Fire damage.

surges.html: Exclude one creature from this spell's area or choose one additional eligible target.

rider.title: FIRE THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to increase its area by 1 unit.
